title: American-Style Bean Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole filled with beans and topped with a crunchy, cheesy crust. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Juicy Ground Beef
ingredients.notes: Choose 80% lean or higher for best results

ingredients.name: American Cheese
ingredients.notes: Can be substituted with cheddar or mozzarella

instructions: Cook the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the kidney beans, cheese, and sprouts to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix the bread crumbs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Sprinkle the bread crumb mixture evenly over the top of the casserole.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the top is golden brown.
Let it rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.
